Bounded by the per-batch 5% crash ceiling and base priors ≤0.13, so expected contamination is ≪1 row, but errors should be excluded from acceptance (`if v.error is None and v.agreed == want_agree`).

The smoke measured villain's frozen pool at max 121 tokens, but comedian/kindergarten/software_engineer frozen pools are unmeasured; a frozen row in (1024, 2048] would now train untruncated where #411 truncated it — a subtle parity asymmetry. Cheap fix: run `validate_pool(..., arm="arm_canned")` (cap MAX_LEN_AB) on the prefetched pool in the arm_canned branch.
